analysis: Phenylketonuria (PKU) is a genetic disorder characterized by a deficiency in the enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase. This enzyme is crucial for the metabolism of the amino acid phenylalanine, converting it into tyrosine. A deficiency in this enzyme leads to the accumulation of phenylalanine, which can cause various health issues including intellectual disability and other neurological problems if not managed properly.
